from pathlib import Path
import ast
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

root = Path('/home/zhuyulab/ns3-workspace')
b = root / 'ns-allinone-3.40/ns-3.40/contrib/opengym/examples/wireless-rl'
ros = root / 'ros2_ws/ros2-multi-robot-automap'
base = '57edcb6'
receipt = b / 'report/assets/20261014_mr3_correction_review/correction_checks.json'
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root)
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def rel(path):
    return str(path.relative_to(root))

expected = {rel(root/'AGENTS.md'), rel(b/'RESEARCH_PLAN.md'),
    rel(b/'IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md'), rel(b/'log.md'), rel(b/'report/README.md'),
    rel(b/'report/ARCHIVE_INDEX.json'), rel(b/'report/20261014_mr3_correction_review.md'),
    rel(ros/'user_guide.md'), rel(ros/'launch_commands.md'),
    rel(ros/'Technical_Manual.md'), rel(receipt)}
changed = set(git('diff', base, '--name-only').decode().splitlines())
changed |= set(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines())
changed.add(rel(receipt))
assert changed == expected, (changed-expected, expected-changed)
assert not git('diff', base, '--', rel(ros/'src'), rel(ros/'scripts'))
runtime = [rel(ros/'src'), rel(ros/'scripts')]
runtime += [rel(p) for p in b.iterdir() if p.suffix in {'.py', '.cc'}]
assert not git('diff', 'c9344e1', '--', *runtime)

local_links = 0
for name in sorted(changed):
    p = root/name
    if p.suffix != '.md':
        continue
    content = p.read_text()
    assert len(re.findall(r'^```[^\n]*$', content, re.M)) % 2 == 0, name
    for target in re.findall(r'(?<!!)\[[^\]\n]+\]\(([^)\n]+)\)', content):
        if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):
            continue
        target = target.split('#')[0].strip('<>')
        resolved = (p.parent/target).resolve()
        assert resolved == receipt or resolved.exists(), (name, target)
        local_links += 1

idx = json.loads((b/'report/ARCHIVE_INDEX.json').read_text())
old_idx = json.loads(git('show', base+':'+rel(b/'report/ARCHIVE_INDEX.json')))
assert idx['files'] == old_idx['files']
old_reports = 0
for item in idx['files']:
    original = git('show', idx['pre_route_commit']+':'+item['path'])
    assert sha(original) == item['sha256'], item['path']
    if '/report/' in item['path']:
        assert (root/item['path']).read_bytes().split(b'\n\n', 1)[1] == original
        old_reports += 1
for path in (b/'report').glob('*.md'):
    if path.name not in {'README.md', '20261014_mr3_correction_review.md'}:
        assert path.read_bytes() == git('show', base+':'+rel(path)), rel(path)
prior_assets = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', base, '--', rel(b/'report/assets')).decode().splitlines()
for name in prior_assets:
    assert (root/name).read_bytes() == git('show', base+':'+name), name
assert (b/'log.md').read_bytes().startswith(git('show', base+':'+rel(b/'log.md')))
backup = idx['original_route_backup']['commit']
for branch in ('p2c1/global-mission-20261012', 'origin/p2c1/global-mission-20261012'):
    assert git('rev-parse', branch).decode().strip() == backup

plan = (b/'IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md').read_text()
checkpoints = ['MR3-P0', 'MR3-P1A', 'MR3-P1B', 'MR3-P1C', 'MR3-P2A', 'MR3-P2B',
    'MR3-P2C', 'MR3-P3A', 'MR3-P3B', 'MR3-P4A', 'MR3-P4B', 'MR3-P5']
assert re.findall(r'^### (MR3-P\w+)[：:]', plan, re.M) == checkpoints
for checkpoint in checkpoints[1:]:
    assert re.search(r'\| '+checkpoint+r' \|[^\n]+\| 未开始 \|', plan)
assert re.search(r'\| MR3-P0 \|[^\n]+\| 文档已交付，待用户验收 \|', plan)
cmds = (ros/'launch_commands.md').read_text()
blocks = re.findall(r'```bash\n(.*?)```', cmds, re.S)
old_blocks = re.findall(r'```bash\n(.*?)```', git('show', base+':'+rel(ros/'launch_commands.md')).decode(), re.S)
assert blocks == old_blocks
for block in blocks:
    proc = subprocess.run(['bash', '-n'], input=block, text=True, capture_output=True)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr
assert set(re.findall(r'\brobot_count:=(\d+)', cmds)) == {'3'}
assert re.findall(r'--robot-count\s+(\d+)', cmds) == ['3', '3']

model = ET.parse(ros/'src/multi_robot/models/turtlebot3_waffle/model.sdf').getroot().find('model')
collisions = [link.get('name')+'/'+c.get('name') for link in model.findall('link') for c in link.findall('collision')]
sensors = [(link.get('name'), sensor.get('name'), [c.text for c in sensor.findall('contact/collision')])
    for link in model.findall('link') for sensor in link.findall('sensor') if sensor.get('type') == 'contact']
assert len(collisions) == 6
assert sensors == [('base_link', 'base_contact', ['base_collision'])]
evaluator = (ros/'src/multi_robot_exploration/multi_robot_exploration/task_evaluator.py').read_text()
tree = ast.parse(evaluator)
contact_subscriptions = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
    and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == 'create_subscription'
    and n.args and isinstance(n.args[0], ast.Name) and n.args[0].id == 'ContactsState']
assert len(contact_subscriptions) == 1
assert 'f"/{name}/collision"' == ast.get_source_segment(evaluator, contact_subscriptions[0].args[1])

source = Path(__file__).read_text()
result = {
    'checked_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'type': 'documentation_correction_static_validation_not_a_simulator_experiment',
    'review_base_commit': git('rev-parse', base).decode().strip(),
    'runtime_source_freeze': git('rev-parse', 'c9344e1').decode().strip(),
    'command': 'rtk proxy python3 /tmp/mr3_correction_check.py',
    'checks': {'changed_files_within_explicit_documentation_scope': len(changed),
        'relevant_tracked_runtime_unchanged': True, 'local_markdown_links': local_links,
        'balanced_fences': True, 'archival_git_object_hashes': len(idx['files']),
        'historical_report_bodies': old_reports, 'all_prior_report_assets_unchanged': len(prior_assets),
        'historical_log_bytes_preserved': True, 'original_backup_unchanged': True,
        'checkpoint_states_unchanged': len(checkpoints), 'bash_syntax_blocks': len(blocks),
        'bash_command_blocks_byte_identical': True, 'recommended_robot_count': 3,
        'physical_collision_bodies': collisions, 'contact_sensors': sensors},
    'file_sha256': {name: sha((root/name).read_bytes()) for name in sorted(changed) if name != rel(receipt)},
    'checker_sha256': sha(source.encode()), 'checker_source': source,
    'simulator_runs': 0, 'training_runs': 0, 'new_performance_claims': 0, 'result': 'PASS'}
receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in {'file_sha256', 'checker_source'}}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
